source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination in Biology (school not named). Page 1 prints 'CLASS IX - ANNUAL EXAMINATION', 'BIOLOGY', 'SCIENCE Paper - 3', '(Two hours)', 'Attempt all questions from Section I and any four questions from Section II'; every page footer prints 'NP20 523' (recorded as paperCode) and page 1 prints 'This paper consists of 10 printed pages.' No overall maximum is printed; maxMarks 80 is the sum of the printed 'SECTION I (40 Marks)' and 'SECTION II (40 Marks)'. No year is printed; examYear 2020 is taken from the file name (icse-class-9-biology-science-np20-523-2020) and the icseboard.org folder. Every sub-question prints only a [5] total for five (or ten) items, so each lettered part is kept as one entry with that total. Section II has six questions (2-7) of which four are to be attempted, so the pack's marks total (100) exceeds 80. Underlined words are shown in [brackets]. A student's ticks on the scan were ignored. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.

questions.sectionTitle: SECTION I (40 Marks) Attempt all questions from this Section
questions.text:
Choose the correct answer from each of the four options given below:
(i) The digestive juice which does not contain any enzyme:
A. Saliva B. Gastric juice C. Bile D. Pancreatic juice
(ii) Which one of the following is a vitamin deficiency disease?
A. Diabetes B. Goitre C. Marasmus D. Scurvy
(iii) Which one of the following diseases is caused by a fungus?
A. Ring worm B. Round worm C. Tape worm D. Typhoid
(iv) Which one of the following is not an antibiotic?
A. Penicillin B. Steapsin C. Streptomycin D. Chloromycetin
(v) The term neuter is given to a flower in which both:
A. Androecium and Gynoecium are present. B. Calyx and Corolla are present. C. Androecium and Gynoecium are absent. D. Calyx and Corolla are absent.
